objective: Test H/b-only neutral initialization on the full native Supra host, with a fresh sampled-initialization editing-only causal control; compare both with fixed historical ordinary/particle references.
scope: One fixed task and named-stream cohort; no seed sweep, Forge/default promotion, raw-output optimization, or claim that the toy result transfers automatically.

sampled_hb_neutral_v1.H_b: Zero only each bridge H columns and bias, after identical sampling/zero-up and before policy/EMA construction.

initialization.initial_up: All 71 up weights zero in both arms.
initialization.sole_difference: FAST and averaged generator H/b tensors; all other initial tensors/optimizers/controllers/native streams equal. C remains nonzero, bit-exact, and trainable.

training.loss: Native paired RpGAN with full KA2 in 16-coordinate token units; normalized live frozen-teacher residual.
training.schedule: fresh_editing_only_v1; fit batches and task weight1 from update1.
training.execution: Two independently owned native loops, interleaved per external update. Same data/Gaussian draws; adaptive native controller responses may differ.
training.structural_guard: Native whole-model candidate reruns; clean learned critic-feature criterion; zero per-context feature harm under FAST plus averaged owners.

streams.required_evidence: Per-step data indices, Gaussian draw digest, owned RNG states and DV12 signatures. Exact random states compared when native actions do not change consumption; do not demand identical later controller decisions.

data.teacher_pairing: Same live BF16 batch shape and CFG; no cached velocity substituted as an exact structural target.

evaluation.primary_head: clean FAST at each fixed endpoint; no automatically selected serving head substitutes for FAST.
evaluation.secondary: DV12 and averaged/native-serving results only if separately labeled and predeclared; no head selection.
evaluation.primary_pool: all240 held-out editing contexts; report all six subject means and per-context values
evaluation.criterion: Mean paired learned generator game softplus(real_score-fake_score), lower is better, independently under both fixed critics.

gaussian_panels.reset: One stream initialized once per full evaluation; consume continuously across fit→test→holds→preservation; reset identically for every model/checkpoint.

evaluation.progress_probe: Predeclared12 or24 test contexts balanced over six source IDs; fixed indices written before updates, private CPU72 Gaussian panels, frozenD1856 and cleanFAST every200; private DV12 secondary. Never used for optimization, stopping or checkpoint/head selection.
evaluation.particle_contributions: At fixed endpoints, zero-code and mass-only routing observational game ablations with the same panels/critics, all71 sites visited.
evaluation.historical_references: Rescore the declared ordinary6400 and exported V2/V3 artifacts on these exact new CPU72 panels; do not copy prior CUDA72 leaderboard values as matched scores.
evaluation.preservation: Secondary visible diagnostic; no requirement to win preservation.

qualification.initial: Only H/b values differ; FAST+averagedC/bank/router/critic/frozen base/data/stream identities exact; zero-up initial full outputs exact.
qualification.native_resume: CPU-map actual checkpoint800→802 replay, exact full native state/rows/RNG; counts separately as software replay updates.
qualification.frozen_owners: Immutable FAST+averaged frozen host/teacher/text contexts/masks/coordinate scales at every saved state.
qualification.particles: 71-site complete execution; nonzero trainableC, dense128-row bank and71-site router gradient/learning after up acquisition; finite clean/DV12 game gradients; final code/mass ablation effects recorded without choosing the sign.
qualification.evaluation_immutability: Full native state/config/RNG before and after probes/reference loading/ablations/export-reload identical.
qualification.provenance: Runtime plan binds this cardSHA, all application/native sourceSHAs, actual fullrecipe, initial tensors, all immutable input fileSHAs, panel hashes and frozenjudge tensors; source held while running.
qualification.export: Strictly tagged sampled initialization mode and GATEDV3 architecture; selected cleanFAST tensors and reload predictions exact.
qualification.success_reporting: Report signed H/b-neutral−sampled-control game changes under both judges at BOTH fixed endpoints; never replace6400 with a better earlier result or assert universal improvement.
